cold1.text: You've learned the grammar. You know the words.

cold2.text: But your accent, and all the extra words, still get in the way.

logo2.text: Your pocket coach for modern British English.

f1.text: Read a sentence aloud, and schwa shows exactly which sounds you made, phoneme by phoneme.

f2.text: Tap any sound to see how it's made. Then say it again. You only move on when you get it right.

f3.text: Say it shorter. Waffle gets struck out, and a crisp British version is waiting for you.

f4.text: Hear a natural British voice, repeat after it, and see your melody traced against theirs.

f5.text: Learn the words Britons actually use, from the supermarket to place names like Leicester.

f6.text: Every sound you practise lands on your progress map. Tap a weak one, and schwa drills it.

f7.text: On a walk or the commute, go hands-free. schwa reads the prompt, listens, and coaches you out loud.

f8.text: And it all runs on your phone. No account, no subscription, and it even works in flight mode.

g2.text: Open the link in Safari or Chrome, and add schwa to your Home Screen.

g3.text: Tap Load offline engine, just once. After that, it's yours.
